contentNote: Public reference snapshot. Account ownership, balances and progress stay local. Community values are snapshots, never guaranteed sale prices. Missing facts stay unknown.

events.title: Factory raid
events.notes: Second Sea: a raid opens 90 minutes after the previous raid ends. The core has a five-minute challenge window; this is server-relative, not a global calendar time.

events.title: Natural fruit spawns
events.notes: Map fruits spawn every hour on weekdays or every 45 minutes on weekends, and disappear after 20 minutes if uncollected. The server phase and fruit are not predicted.

timerPresets.title: Normal dealer restock
timerPresets.notes: Shared rotations at 00:00, 04:00, 08:00, 12:00, 16:00 and 20:00 UTC. The timer does not identify current stock.

timerPresets.title: Advanced dealer restock
timerPresets.notes: Shared even-hour UTC rotation. This does not predict when Mirage Island appears.

timerPresets.title: Blox Fruit Gacha
timerPresets.notes: Start after rolling a fruit on this account.

timerPresets.title: Next Factory raid
timerPresets.notes: Start when the current Factory raid ends. Applies only to the same server.

timerPresets.title: Factory challenge window
timerPresets.notes: Start when the Factory opens. The core may be destroyed before the timer ends.

timerPresets.title: Natural fruit spawn cycle
timerPresets.notes: Weekday baseline; choose the weekend variant on weekends. Start from a witnessed spawn or match the server countdown.

timerPresets.title: Natural fruit despawn
timerPresets.notes: Start when the fruit spawns, not when you first notice it.
